evidence.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq surge to record highs after AI chipmaker rally
evidence.body: [e001:f01] At market’s close, the S&P 500 was up 0.58%, topping 7,800 for the first time in its history. [e001:f02] The tech-heavy Nasdaq index rose 0.45%, while the Dow, which is slightly down from its record high in August, climbed 0.49%. [e001:f03] Investors appeared optimistic after recent developments for chipmakers including Marvell Technology, Advanced Micro Devices and Broadcom that showed growth in the markets for the chips used to power AI. [e001:f04] Wall Street has also grown more optimistic that the US Federal Reserve will leave interest rates unchanged at its next board meeting in October. [e001:f05] Job figures from September showed underwhelming growth in the labor market, and multiple Fed officials have said the next interest rate increase can probably wait. [e001:f06] The optimism in the stock market, largely coming from continuing investment in AI, has defied other signs of instability in the US economy and global politics. [e001:f07] The US bond market, typically seen as one of the safest investment vehicles, has been in turmoil in recent weeks. [e001:f08] US bond yields, or the return an investor receives when a bond matures, reached recent highs amid concerns over high inflation and interest rates. [e001:f09] The yield for 10-year US treasury bonds on Monday reached 5.349%, the highest since April 2022, before dipping back down on Tuesday. [e001:f10] For American consumers, higher energy prices continue to be a major pain point. [e001:f11] While gas prices have dipped over the last week, prices are still about $1.20 a gallon on average higher than a year ago. [e001:f12] Diesel, which is used to fuel trucks, buses and trains, has also gone down from record high but is still over 40% higher than a year ago. [e001:f13] The economy is expected to be a top issue in the upcoming midterm elections, with many voters expressing frustration over high prices. [e001:f14] Donald Trump, who has been stumping for Republican candidates across the country, has been trying to paint a different picture for voters. [e001:f15] At a rally in Nebraska on Monday night, Trump said that “our nation is doing better now than it’s ever done” and that gas prices would fall below $1.85 a gallon “in no time”.

evidence.title: Update: S&P 500, Nasdaq Hit Record Highs as Focus Shifts to Fed Minutes
evidence.body: [e005:f01] EDT 3 min read ^GSPC ^IXIC ^DJI wall street stock market flag new york trading equity -Shutterstock (Updates with market moves at the end of the day, and other changes, if any.) The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite hit record highs on Tuesday as Treasury yields declined ahead of the Federal Reserve's meeting minutes due Wednesday. [e005:f02] The S&P 500 added 0.6% to settle at 7,818.93, while the Nasdaq gained 0.5% to 27,599.79 to notch a back-to-back new peak. [e005:f03] Both are up for the fourth and fifth day in a row, respectively. [e005:f04] The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.5% to 51,521.28, extending its rally into the fourth session. [e005:f05] The 10-year Treasury yield was last down 3.2 basis points at 5.28%, while the two-year rate fell 3.8 basis points to 4.80%. [e005:f06] The Fed will publish the minutes from its September meeting on Wednesday, offering insights into the monetary policy trajectory. [e005:f07] Policymakers announced a 25-basis-point rate increase at the meeting, marking the first rate hike in just over three years aimed at bringing elevated inflation back to the 2% target. [e005:f08] Markets are currently pricing in an 81% probability that the Fed will keep its benchmark rate steady later this month, according to the CME FedWatch tool. [e005:f09] In economic news, the US trade deficit increased in August to its highest level since March 2025 as imports hit a record high, official data showed Tuesday. [e005:f10] "Although net trade is on track to pose a sizeable drag on (third-quarter gross domestic product), roughly half of the drag will be offset by a 1.4 (percentage point) contribution to GDP growth from booming equipment spending," Zwemmer said. [e005:f11] Brent crude oil was up 0.7% at $100.99 a barrel in Tuesday late-afternoon trade, while West Texas Intermediate rose 0.4% to $89.81. [e005:f12] In other company news, Constellation Energy (CEG) shares jumped 12%, among the top gainers on the S&P 500. [e005:f13] The company agreed to collaborate with Alphabet's (GOOG, GOOGL) Google on 3,590 megawatts of power as part of a long-term energy strategy to meet demand and improve grid reliability. [e005:f14] Drug distributor McKesson (MCK) and private investment firm Clayton Dubilier & Rice agreed to acquire Option Care Health (OPCH) in a roughly $5.8 billion deal. [e005:f15] Option Care's shares surged 33%, while those of McKesson added 0.6%. [e005:f16] Spot gold rose 0.7% to $4,168.69 per troy ounce, while silver climbed 0.8% to $61.81 per ounce.

evidence.title: 弱い雇用でもドル円157円台 なぜ米10年金利は5％超？ メキシコペソ急落も整理【相場の現在地】2026/10/4
evidence.body: [e003:f01] メキシコペソ急落も整理【相場の現在地】2026/10/4 週刊FXレポート 米ドル FXレポート CFDレポート WTI原油 金スポット 日本円 メキシコペソ PickUp 今週（9月28日週）の為替市場では、米国のインフレ指標と雇用統計がいずれも「追加利上げを急ぐ必要はない」と受け止められる内容となりました。 [e003:f02] 実際、10月のFOMC（米連邦公開市場委員会）で追加利上げが行われるとの市場予想は、週初には約70％まで高まっていましたが、今週末には20％前後まで低下しました。 [e003:f03] 米10年国債利回りは週中に一時5.34％と約24年ぶりの高水準まで上昇し、弱い米雇用統計が発表された2日も、いったん低下した後に再び5.28％台まで上昇しました。 [e003:f04] ドル円は雇用統計後にドル安・円高へ動いたものの、週末時点では1ドル＝157.79円。 [e003:f05] 三つ目は、 その高い米長期金利を背景に、ドル円が157円台と高い水準に残っている ことです。 [e003:f06] 週初から米国債は売られ、10年金利は5.3％台へ 今週も、まず相場を大きく動かしたのは米国債市場でした。 [e003:f07] 米10年国債利回りは週中に一時5.34％まで上昇し、2002年以来およそ24年ぶりの高水準となりました。 [e003:f08] 食品とエネルギーを除くコアPCEも前月比0.2％上昇、前年比3.0％上昇となり、FRBが10月に急いで追加利上げをする必要性は低下しました。 [e003:f09] 雇用統計は+2.9万人 「強い雇用」の前提も変わった そして週末2日に発表された9月の米雇用統計は、今週の流れをさらに明確にしました。 [e003:f10] ところが米10年国債利回りは発表直後に低下した後、再び上昇して5.28％台となりました。 [e003:f11] 弱い雇用 ↓ 米景気先行きにやや不透明感 ↓ FRB追加利上げ観測は後退 したにもかかわらず、 長期国債には売りが残り ↓ 米10年金利は5％を大きく上回った からです。 [e003:f12] 10月のFRB追加利上げ観測が週初の約70％から20％前後まで低下したことを考えると、ドル円の下落は限定的だったといえます。 [e003:f13] FRBが10月に利上げする可能性が低下した ↓ 短期的にはドル売り材料 である一方、 米10年金利は5％を大きく上回る ↓ 米国債の高い利回りは残る ↓ ドルを支える材料 となっています。 [e003:f14] さらに米10年国債利回りは5％を超えて上昇しています。 [e003:f15] 一方で、米10年国債利回りは同じ日に5.28％台まで上昇しました。 [e003:f16] 北海ブレント原油は100ドル超の高水準 ＋ ディーゼルなど燃料需給も逼迫 ＋ 米国の財政・国債供給への警戒 ↓ 米長期国債への売りが続く ↓ 米10年金利は一時5.34％ その一方で PCEが予想より弱い ＋ 9月雇用者数は+2.9万人 ↓ 米国景気先行きにやや不透明感 ↓ 10月のFRB追加利上げ観測は約70％から20％前後へ低下 しかし 長期金利は5％を大きく上回ったまま ↓ ドル円も157円台に残る さらにFX市場では FRBは9月に利上げ ＋ Banxicoは6.50％で据え置き ↓ 米墨の政策金利差が縮小 ＋ 米長期金利は5％超 ↓ ペソロングの魅力が低下・ポジション調整が意識 ↓ メキシコペソ安圧力 一方、株式市場では 弱い雇用 ↓ 10月利上げ回避への期待 ↓ NASDAQなどが上昇 金市場では 弱い雇用よりも5％超の長期金利が重く ↓ 金は下落 となりました。

evidence.title: Fed’s Bowman Decries ‘Antiquated’ Analysis Blocking Rural Bank Mergers
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Bowman said Tuesday (Oct. [e004:f02] In a speech delivered at the Community Banking Research Conference in St. [e004:f03] Louis, Missouri, Bowman said that over the past two years the Fed has acted to support community banks by refocusing its supervision on risks that could impact a firm’s financial condition, by working with banking agencies to update the community bank leverage ratio and by eliminating the Novel Activities Supervision Program to support community bank innovation. [e004:f04] One area in which work remains to be done is mergers and acquisitions. [e004:f05] The Federal Reserve’s competitive analysis in bank mergers disproportionately affects rural banks in small and underserved markets and understates the competition these banks face, Bowman said. [e004:f06] We’d love to be your preferred source for news . [e004:f07] Please add us to your preferred sources list so our news, data and interviews show up in your feed. [e004:f08] Add as Preferred Source “This analysis is antiquated and harmful to community banks that may face greater difficulties in merging, even when doing so may actually create a stronger and more competitive banking environment,” Bowman said. [e004:f09] Bowman also highlighted de novo formation and said that the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC) issued a statement in June reaffirming its support for de novo bank formation. [e004:f10] “While this was an important show of broad-based support for de novos, federal and state banking agencies can and should do more to promote new bank formation — including clarifying approval standards (like capital requirements), adhering to specific and reasonable processing timelines, and issuing conditional approvals where appropriate,” Bowman said. [e004:f11] A third area in which work remains is in rationalizing and streamlining the call report, Bowman said, referring to the Consolidated Reports of Condition and Income . [e004:f12] “The FFIEC issued a request for information on call report streamlining in December 2025, seeking public comment about excessive burden on banks that file the call report and requesting stakeholders to identify options for streamlining,” Bowman said. [e004:f13] PYMNTS reported in June 2025, when Bowman was sworn in as vice chair for supervision at the Federal Reserve, that past speeches and papers showed that Bowman might drive a rollback of several regulations, with a guiding principle that seeks to relax some mandates on smaller financial institutions , and address risks in the system. evidence.title: Bradbury Capital Completes Business Combination And Raises $5 Million PIPE Ahead Of Nasdaq Debut
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Following completion, the combined company has changed its name to Bradbury Capital Inc. [e006:f02] Its ordinary shares and warrants are expected to begin trading on Nasdaq on October 7, 2026, under BBCI and BBCI W, respectively. [e006:f03] Bradbury Capital operates through Malaysian subsidiary Super Apps Holding and strategic partnerships focused on electronic voucher services and digital payment solutions. [e006:f04] The transaction gives the company access to the U.S. public capital markets as it pursues additional technology development and expansion across Southeast Asia and other markets. [e006:f05] An investor purchased 625,000 ordinary shares in the private investment. [e006:f06] Bradbury plans to use its public listing and strengthened capital markets position to support expansion of its electronic voucher and payment technology activities while pursuing additional partnerships and market opportunities. [e006:f07] The Law Offices of Jenny Chen-Drake served as U.S. legal counsel to Bradbury, while Loeb & Loeb represented TETE. [e006:f08] Ogier advised on Cayman Islands matters and Darryl, Edward & Co. served as Malaysian legal adviser to Bradbury. **KEY QUOTES:** _“We are proud to begin trading on Nasdaq, a milestone that reflects the dedication of our team and the trust of our investors. [e006:f09] This is an exciting new chapter for Bradbury Capital as we work to expand our electronic voucher services and digital payment solutions across Southeast Asia and beyond. [e006:f10] With our newly strengthened platform and access to the U.S. capital markets, we are well positioned to accelerate innovation, forge strategic partnerships, and create long-term value for our shareholders.”_ **Keith Loo See Yuen, Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Bradbury Capital** _“We are pleased to have completed the Business Combination with Bradbury Holdings. [e006:f11] The Company’s proven track record in digital payments and electronic voucher services, combined with its ambitious growth strategy, made it an ideal partner for this transaction. [e006:f12] We look forward to supporting the Company’s next phase of growth as it scales its technology platform and pursues new market opportunities.”_ **Tek Che Ng, Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of Technology & Telecommunication Acquisition Corporation**。

evidence.title: （朝）米国市場は主要3指数が続伸 石油備蓄の放出決定と弱めの米雇用統計が投資家心理を上向かせる
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 株式 マネックス 日経平均 【米国株式市場】ニューヨーク市場 NYダウ： 51,176.96 △250.40 （10/2） NASDAQ： 27,190.86 △319.27 （10/2） 1.概況 2日の米国市場では、ダウ平均とS＆P500種株価指数、ナスダック総合株価指数がそろって続伸しました。 [e007:f02] 主要7カ国（G7）による石油備蓄の放出決定を受けて、原油安が進行するなか投資家心理が上向きました。 [e007:f03] また、米国で発表された9月の雇用統計では非農業部門雇用者数の前月からの増加幅が市場予想を下回るなど、緩やかなペースでの雇用回復を示す結果となりました。 [e007:f04] 2.経済指標等 9月のユーロ圏消費者物価指数（CPI）速報値は前年比3.8%上昇と市場予想（同3.5%上昇）を上回り、2023年9月以来の高い伸びとなりました。 [e007:f05] エネルギー・食料品・アルコール・タバコを除くコアCPIは同2.5％上昇と市場予想（同2.6％上昇）をやや下回ったものの、前月（同2.4％上昇）から伸びが高まりました。 [e007:f06] 9月の米雇用統計では、非農業部門雇用者数が前月比2万9000人増と市場予想（同9万5000人増）を下回る増加幅にとどまり、下方修正された前月分の同13万3000人増（速報値：同16万2000人増）を大幅に下回りました。 [e007:f07] また、失業率は4.2％と前月（4.1％）から悪化したほか、平均時給は前年比3.0%増と市場予想（同3.2％増）や前月（同3.1％増）を下回る伸びにとどまりました。 [e007:f08] 3.業種別動向 2日の米国市場でS＆P500の業種別株価指数は11業種中10業種が上昇、下落したのは1業種のみとなりました。 [e007:f09] 上昇した業種は、一般消費財・サービスが1.4％高、情報技術は1.1％高と続きました。 [e007:f10] 一方、ヘルスケアは0.04%安と小幅に下落しました。 [e007:f11] シスコシステムズ［CSCO］が3.2％高と構成銘柄における上昇率トップ、続いてキャタピラー［CAT］が2.3高、ユナイテッドヘルス・グループ［UNH］は1.8％高となりました。 [e007:f12] 一方、11銘柄が下落し、ナイキ［NKE］が3.6％安となりました。 [e007:f13] スマートデバイス向けの半導体を手掛けるシナプティクス［SYNA］の買収に関する金額が従前の約70億ドルから約57億ドルに引き下げられたと伝わり、市場では好感されました。 [e007:f14] VIEW POINT: 今日の視点 弱めの米雇用統計などを背景に10月下旬に開催される米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）で利上げが行われるとの観測は後退しており、株式市場に対する追い風とみられます。 [e007:f15] こうしたなか、目先の日経平均株価は約3ヶ月ぶりとなる7万円の大台をうかがう流れになり得ると考えられます。 [e007:f16] 今週は10月7日に9月に開催されたFOMCの議事要旨が公表される予定で、今後の利上げペースを巡る思惑から市場は上下に振れる可能性があります。

previous_updates.title: Nasdaq、Nasdaq-100イベント契約を第4四半期に投入へ
previous_updates.summary: NasdaqはSECの承認を受け、Nasdaq-100指数を参照するイベント契約を2026年第4四半期に投入する計画を示した。 指数事業は第2四半期に34商品を新規投入し、このうち17商品が海外向け、11商品が機関投資家向け年金分野だった。 直近12カ月の純資金流入の38％は過去5年以内、22％は過去3年以内に投入した商品が生み、12月6日には23時間・週5日取引の開始も予定する。
